Pemtron.why: Makes 3D wafer-bump, wire-bonding and memory-module vision inspection systems and won an HBM inspection equipment order in 2025; memory makers' packaging build-outs (Micron Memory Malaysia contracts) drive its semiconductor inspection sales.
Pemtron.evidence: Pemtron half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): high-bandwidth memory (HBM) semiconductor inspection equipment order in 2025; semiconductor inspection equipment supply contracts with Micron Memory Malaysia SDN. BHD. (KRW 4,998M and KRW 3,149M).

players.product: 3D wafer-bump, wire-bonding and memory-module vision inspection systems (HBM inspection)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 40,943,213,610 (H1 2025: KRW 27,804,519,787) and operating profit KRW 349,931,214 (H1 2025: operating loss KRW 2,759,389,881); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 24,004,276,738 (Q2 2025: KRW 16,711,700,723) and Q2 operating profit KRW 1,393,395,009 (Q2 2025: KRW 259,209,424); H1 net loss KRW 3,641,593,069 (H1 2025: KRW 7,563,715,062). By product: SMT inspection KRW 29,975,892 thousand (73.2%), semiconductor inspection KRW 10,967,321 thousand (26.8%)
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 40,943,213,610; operating profit KRW 349,931,214

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor inspection products: 3D wafer-bump inspection (FC-BGA bump solder, coining and pre-coat, foreign material, metal mask), wire-bonding inspection, package outer-appearance inspection for OSATs and memory-module final inspection. Company history lists a memory-module inspection order in 2024, a high-bandwidth memory (HBM) semiconductor inspection equipment order in 2025 and a next-generation memory-module inspection order in 2026; the company says wafer inspection is an oligopoly of itself and two overseas firms. H1 2026 R&D KRW 7,188M (17.56% of revenue)
SMT inspection supply contract with KTG INTERNATIONAL CORPORATION (first disclosed 2026-03-10, term 2026-03-10 to 2026-09-30), KRW 2,251M supplied in H1 2026; exports 70.1% of sales
